label: ENGINEERING_ONLY
what: The joined, gated seven-node G.1b run directory written under the G.1b sealed root before the REL-T1-G1B copy.
why: The reviewed copy step requires the summary under the G.1b spec's sealed root (sealed_g1b, no symlink on the path), so the joined, gated run directory is written there first (G.5 draft revision 13, section 3).

provenance.note: The four files are byte-identical to the official joined assembly on TASL-2 and to the committed records on main; runs.jsonl is not committed on main, and its sha256 equals the crosscheck gate's runs_jsonl_sha256. No sealed attempt directory, summary value or label was modified; only a new directory of the four assembly files was added under sealed_g1b.
